newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to split Public Works Secretariat in two.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to split Public Works Secretariat in two.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said Wednesday the Public Works and Services Secretariat will be divided in two.
The new Energy and Transport Secretariat will be headed by Alfredo Mirkin, while a slimmed-down Public Works and Services Secretariat will be run by Armando Guivert.

"The division of the secretariat is due to a political decision by President Carlos Menem to give more emphasis to the area of public works, because it has a big impact on economic reactivation and creating jobs," Fernandez told reporters.
Former Public Works Secretary Carlos Bastos resigned Tuesday. He was closely linked to Fernandez's predecessor, Domingo Cavallo.
Bastos had been responsible for the privatization of the giant Yacyreta hydroelectric dam. There has still been no official announcement as to who will be responsible for the sale.
